steps: Roll falling: the whole roll fell in each of the last three year-on-year moves (four consecutive censuses), starting from at least 50 pupils.

Entry cohort shrinking: the school's pupils at its entry age (11 for a school with a GCSE phase starting at 11 or younger, else Reception age for a primary, else 16) changed over two years by as much as or more than the national bottom-fifth threshold for that phase's entry cohorts.

Results faster than the set: we take the school's change in its headline (Attainment 8, or A-level points per entry) over two years, and the middle (median) change of the set's schools with both years.
The results flag shows when the school's change differs from the set's middle by at least 2 Attainment 8 points or 3 A-level points, and at least 4 set schools have both years.
Each flag shows the figures behind it.

sources: DfE school census (January), the school's own

steps: We take the school's roll in each January census from 2019/20 (after any Pupils or Day and boarding filter). A boarding school with no boarding filter shows a day line and a boarding line instead.
